svg.title: Toxicity and hallucination are different risks
svg.desc: Toxicity is harmful generated text measured by classifiers over many continuations. Hallucination can conflict with real-world facts (factuality) or with the provided input (faithfulness). FActScore checks atomic claims against sources; grounding and abstention reduce risk but do not eliminate it.

g.text: Toxicity and hallucination are different risks
Next-token training favors fluent text; classifiers, evidence, and abstention add checks.
Mitigate: filter data → safety tune / align
Watch false positives: over-refusal blocks valid help.
Split into atomic claims → check sources
RAG helps, but does not eliminate unsupported claims.
